name: Mary Magdalene
bio: Mary Magdalene followed Jesus from Galilee and ministered to him, and was among the women who watched his crucifixion from a distance and kept vigil at his tomb afterward (Matthew 27:55-61). At dawn on the first day of the week, she and the other Mary came to the tomb and were met by an angel announcing Jesus's resurrection; as they hurried away afraid yet overjoyed, Jesus himself met them, and they took hold of his feet and worshipped him (Matthew 28:1-10). Mark's account notes that Jesus had cast seven demons out of her, and that he appeared to her first after rising, though the disciples did not believe her report (Mark 16:9-11). Luke names her, along with Joanna and Mary the mother of James, as the women who found the empty tomb, met two angels, and reported the news to the apostles, though the apostles dismissed it as nonsense (Luke 24:1-11).
